decisions.reason: §1 F2 uses the titled-but-unavailable tab, meta.status stuck at 'none', and the same-file file-trace contrast to localize the fault to the workspace-files resource-provider/RPC chain — not disk existence, static serving, or the external plugin — while admitting the exact stall link needs host-side confirmation.

§2 separates the valid per-module 62/62 sweep from the invalid 4–5 KB joined URL, attributing its 404 to request-shape/URL-length limits and mishandled per-row revs; the 60-vs-62 count is reported verbatim as a capture-time discrepancy without invented reconciliation.

§3 keeps the paste-input fold warnings as a separate cosmetic warning family, and explains textpreview→documentpreview with the session-only canOpen scope accounting for F1 (absolute-address claim failure) but not the session tab's stalled metadata (F2).

§4 orders restart-and-reverify → rollback to the #5999-verified 0.1.3-alpha.2 escape hatch → upstream report; rejects plugin rewrite/retry/fallback and cites the alpha.1 roster mismatch as prior art whose fix did not cure F2.

§5 packages versions/upgrade history, exact addresses and symptoms, roster with count discrepancy, probe table with the invalid join labeled, contrast and meta.status, and proposes named host diagnostics (service-registration assertion, session-root resolution, loud consumer fallback); it treats per-module 200s as insufficient proof of the served chain.

caps.reason: The joined-URL 404 is explicitly labeled an invalid probe whose result is evidence about the probe, never cited as missing modules.
Plugin workarounds, retries, and fallback readers are rejected as wrong-owner/noise/path-forking; no duplicate service insertion is proposed.
